dialogue.speech: But doesn't DIO's body belong to the Joestar bloodline?

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: The fact that his hair turned blond may be a sign that

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: the DIO blood in him, his Stand power, recently awakened.

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: There might have been a trigger...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: like a powerful Stand user being in that city.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: A powerful Stand user?

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: Don't go near him anymore.

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: It's dangerous to take this further.

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: Understand?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Just one last question...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Is he our enemy?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Or is he a friend?

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: What do you think?

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: You're the one who actually met him.

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: What was your impression of him?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I'm not sure.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: But, um...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: He seemed like a very eloquent person.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Did you drop this?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: No.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I see.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Guess it's mine now.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Let's say you found a bag with , lire inside.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: would you take it to the authorities?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: No way. I'd totally take it.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Well, aren't you honest?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But what if I was a plainclothes police officer and saw you take it?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I'd give you half and have you look the other way... probably.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Wow, that's great!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And I'm sure that's actually what you'd do.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You're not kidding or bluffing.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I can tell! You're telling the truth.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You see... I can tell if people are telling the truth or not.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm almost certain.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You know how your skin gets shiny when you sweat?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That's how I can tell.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I think I'll have an even better idea if I taste your sweat.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Who are you?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Leaky Eye Luca was found on the ground near the airport after having

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: his own spade buried in the back of his head.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's a rather serious injury. He won't be regaining consciousness.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm trying to find out who's responsible.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno Giovanna, no one knows why Leaky Eye Luca was at the airport.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But the airport security guards

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: let me know that you were at the airport.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That's why I figured I'd come see you and ask you some questions.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Are you actually a police officer?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Of course not.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Luca's no ordinary crook. He's a g*ng member.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There are plenty of reasons he might've been taken out.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: He knew how to get people to hate him.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But that's not what his boss is thinking about.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The boss feels like his name was

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: personally tarnished since one of his own was taken out.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That's why he told me to find out who took him out and settle the score.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm asking you...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Did you happen to run into Leaky Eye Luca at the airport?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: No. I don't know who you're talking about.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You're not sweating.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: All right, I'll believe you.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That does it for my questions.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Sorry to have bothered you, Giorno Giovanna.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: What is that?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: My hand was clenched the whole time.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That's Luca's right eye.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: He's unconscious anyway, so I just brought it.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This taste... is the taste of someone who's lying, Giorno Giovanna!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Well, well, well, well...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I said I was done with my questions,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: but the situation seems to have changed, Giorno Giovanna.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You told me a lie.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: And now, I'm going to have to find out why you lied to me, aren't I?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What are you looking at?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Are you jealous?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Did you want to hit him, too?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: My name is Bruno Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Answer me.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Your questioning has already turned into t*rture.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Well? This is a pretty creepy ability, isn't it?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Th-That's...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Those are Luca's fingers.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: To tell you the truth...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Leaky Eye Luca was disposed of by our boss.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: He said that there's no point in him living anymore.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I took his fingers for torturing.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's happening again! What the hell?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Is he also like that Japanese tourist?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Other than being able to tell if people are lying or not, I can also do this...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I can put whatever I want in your mouth.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: For example...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I can even put that fire extinguisher in your mouth.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Though I'm afraid you'd die if I did that...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Talk!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You know who's responsible.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Were you told not to tell anyone?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Let's have you tell me who did Luca in.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: There's no doubt about it... He has a similar ability!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If you don't hurry up and tell me, your t*rture is just going to get worse,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno Giovanna!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: This guy's bad news!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: In that case...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I'll have to use Golden Wind and dodge his attacks!
